item.title: Version 1.1
item.changes: Tabs: open several projects in one window. ⌘T opens a new tab, ⌘W closes one, and ⇧⌘[ / ⇧⌘] switch between them. Copy and paste: clips pasted into another project bring their media with them. HDR: projects can now be HDR, keeping bright highlights in the viewer and in exports. Turn it on in the Dynamic range section of the Inspector. Shortcuts: Add Text is now ⌃T, and File > New opens a new tab.
